purpose: Represent changes across distinct property interests and holder roles between two verified states without collapsing every change into ownership.
rules: Registered proprietor is not synonymous with beneficial owner.
Mortgage or charge holder is not synonymous with property owner.
Personal representative role is distinct from personal beneficial ownership.
Joint tenancy and tenancy in common must be represented separately.
Easement/right-of-way holder and burdened owner are distinct roles.
An unchanged ownership interest may coexist with a changed security, lease, easement or beneficial interest.
A change in one dimension must not be used to infer changes in unrelated dimensions.
Holder identity requires property/date/document evidence where material.
hard_stops: Never label every matrix change as ownership change.
Never infer beneficial ownership from registered title alone.
Never infer discharge from absence of an event document alone where registration evidence is material.
Never infer holder identity from names without property/date matching.
Never hide an unresolved interest dimension.
